summary: Braskem S.A. furnished a Form 6-K (Brazilian equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) reproducing its November 10, 2026 response to CVM Official Letter 296/2026/SEP/GEA-1 seeking comment on press reports. Braskem confirms it retained financial and legal advisors, has exchanged non-binding restructuring proposals with note and debenture holders, and filed an extrajudicial reorganization petition on August 24, 2026. Reports cite bondholders rejecting conversion of US$3.8 billion of debt into equity, shareholders withdrawing a capital injection, a November 6 consensual deadline lapsing and a November 22 judicial deadline. Watch whether a judicial reorganization filing follows and how recovery terms shift.
